harmonic_candidates.method: UTide 0.4.0 OLS with astronomical nodal/Greenwich corrections, fixed annual fit; no provider amplitudes/phases

protocol.quality_rules: NOAA verified q=v when present and all flags zero; UHSLC finite sea_level and quality>=3; keep quality distribution. Reject duplicate times or changing record/datum, no interpolation.
assumptions: UHSLC is delayed-mode 4-6 week FD/RQ archive, not operational telemetry. Short-horizon replay assumes event-time local sensor access which this archive does not establish.
NOAA MLLW and UHSLC reference datums are local, never pooled as common elevation.
2024 and previously inspected 2025 observations may be used for development; all 2026 blocks are new held-out results and must not be retuned after viewing.
Short horizon does not replace long-open-loop qualification. Hourly UHSLC supports 1h/6h only; six-minute extension evaluated only for NOAA.
No wind/surge physical model, bathymetry, UKC, equipment or energy field calibration is implied.

protocol_errata.reason: UTide 0.4.0 does not register M1; remove this unsupported name before any test predictions or metrics. No thresholds, target periods or observed outcomes used to choose the repair.

protocol.training_supplement_reason: Fremantle 2024 had only4330 valid training hours (<7000). Supplement2023 real observed training history before any2026 test prediction; preserve data gaps, same quality filters, thresholds and test periods.
